basic_info.description: In an ideal location, just a few blocks from the vibrant Divisadero Street Corridor is this luxury NOPA condo with three bedrooms, three bathrooms and flex / media room. This home offers acute attention to detail throughout its two levels of living. The property was extensively renovated with the highest level of finishes and fixtures while maintaining the stunning Victorian facade.  The interior offers a well-crafted floor plan with scale, light and comfort featuring high ceilings, seven foot doors, glass surround staircase and southern exposed windows. The living area has a gas fireplace flanked by a dining area. The large chefs' kitchen has matching grain flat panel cabinetry, Calacutta Oro counters and Bosch appliances. The master suite features sliding glass doors that access a private deck. There is also room for an office on the main floor. Downstairs, you will find a flex / media room, an additional bedroom and bathroom. The home is wired for media and has radiant heat throughout with multiple zones managed through a Nest system.
